query_source: Dune raw-SQL API over the curated bnb.transactions table
sql: WITH tx_daily AS (SELECT block_date AS day, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM bnb.transactions WHERE block_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-08-22' GROUP BY 1), addresses AS (SELECT block_date AS day, "from" AS address FROM bnb.transactions WHERE block_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-08-22' UNION ALL SELECT block_date AS day, "to" AS address FROM bnb.transactions WHERE block_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-08-22'), active_daily AS (SELECT day, COUNT(DISTINCT address) AS active_addresses FROM addresses WHERE address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT CAST(t.day AS VARCHAR) AS date, a.active_addresses, t.transaction_count FROM tx_daily t JOIN active_daily a ON t.day = a.day ORDER BY t.day
